snippet.title: Backrooms: Extractions -  Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the terrifying maze of the Backrooms in Backrooms: Extractions, a co-op horror experience built with Unreal Engine 5. Set in 2062, up to 6 players take on the role of MEG operatives tasked with rescuing lost agents and escaping deadly entities across multiple eerie levels.

Explore 8 unique levels, use advanced tools and survive encounters with creatures like Smilers, Skin Stealers, and PartyGoers. Extract your team before it's too late… or become part of the Backrooms forever.

👥 1-6 player co-op
🎯 Tactical tools & teamwork
⚠️ Terrifying entities
🧠 Puzzle-solving under pressure

Buy now and prepare to descend:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835530/Backrooms_Extractions/

#BackroomsExtractions #HorrorGame #UnrealEngine5 #CoopHorror #BackroomsGame #indiegame
